metadata.description: Captured POST /api/mam/enterpriseapprepository/applications/bulksearch. Read-oriented search operation (POST used to carry a package_identifiers list in the body, not a resource-creating mutation) -- no create/delete cleanup required. Live-captured against <internal-env> (26.2), org group 138883 (sdktest), 2026-08-10. EMPIRICAL FINDING: a request body containing only package_identifiers (no platform/locale) returned HTTP 500 on this tenant/build; adding platform:"WIN_RT" and locale:"en-US" (both declared optional in swagger's BulkSearchRequestV2Model) made the call succeed with 200. Swagger does not mark platform/locale as required, but the live server appears to need at least platform populated for this operation to succeed -- treat as required in practice until confirmed against another environment.
